lines.text: Mammoths were alive when the pyramids went up.
And wait till you hear how long they lasted.
About ten thousand years ago, rising seas trapped a few mammoths on an Arctic island.
lines.caption: About 10,000 years ago, rising seas trapped a few mammoths on an Arctic island.

lines.text: Wrangel Island, off Siberia. The herd started with fewer than ten.
lines.caption: Wrangel Island, off Siberia. The herd started with fewer than 10.

lines.text: Then it grew to about three hundred.
lines.caption: Then it grew to about 300.

lines.text: Around twenty-five sixty BC, Egypt was building the Great Pyramid.
lines.caption: Around 2560 BC, Egypt was building the Great Pyramid.

lines.text: The mammoths? Still there, for centuries. The last ones died out about four thousand years ago.
lines.caption: The mammoths? Still there, for centuries. The last ones died out about 4,000 years ago.
